# systemd Report Receiver

Collects metrics from every systemd report source on the host: the
sockets under /run/systemd/report/ that serve the io.systemd.Metrics
Varlink interface (systemd v260 or newer). Each source becomes a
resource identified by its systemd unit.

Sources include systemd's own services (the manager, networkd, journald and, from v262, basic host,
cgroup and file system sources) and any Go daemon publishing with the
[sdmetrics provider SDK](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/rossedman/sdmetrics/provider).

The receiver is a scraper built with `scraperhelper`, so it has the standard
`collection_interval`, `initial_delay` and `timeout` settings. It is
developed in the [sdmetrics](https://github.com/rossedman/sdmetrics)
repository first and intended for proposal to
opentelemetry-collector-contrib.

On hosts older than systemd v260 the receiver logs one warning and reports
no sources.

## Configuration

```yaml
receivers:
  systemdreport:
    collection_interval: 30s
    include: ["io.systemd.*"]

service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      receivers: [systemdreport]
      exporters: [otlp]
```

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collection_interval` | `30s` | Time between scrapes. |
| `timeout` | none | Bound on one whole scrape (scraperhelper). |
| `directory` | `/run/systemd/report` | Report directory. Per-user sources live in `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/systemd/report`. |
| `include` | all | Only sources whose name matches one of these [`path.Match`](https://pkg.go.dev/path#Match) patterns. |
| `exclude` | none | Skip sources matching these patterns. |
| `source_timeout` | `2s` | Time allowed per source. |
| `concurrency` | `8` | Sources scraped at once. |
| `naming` | `raw` | `raw` keeps systemd's family names; `otel` converts them to OpenTelemetry style. |
| `resource` | none | Attributes added to every source's resource. |
| `service_names` | none | `service.name` per source name. |
| `units` | none | `systemd.unit.name` per source name, for socket-activated sources on systemd older than v262. |
| `self_metrics` | `true` | Emit the `sdmetrics.*` metrics about the scrape. |

A full example is in [testdata/config.yaml](testdata/config.yaml).

## Metrics

The metrics are whatever the sources report, so they are not listed in
`metadata.yaml`. The mapping:

| systemd type | OpenTelemetry |
| --- | --- |
| `gauge` | Gauge |
| `counter` | Sum, monotonic, cumulative |
| `string` | Gauge = 1, with the string in the `systemd.value` attribute |
| other (such as v262's `object`) | dropped, counted in `sdmetrics.metrics.dropped` |

Fields become point attributes and a value's object becomes
`systemd.object`. Resource attributes: `host.name`, `host.id`,
`systemd.report.source`, `systemd.unit.name`, `process.pid`,
`service.name`. The `systemd.*` names are proposals that would be raised
with the semantic conventions group before beta.

With `self_metrics`, a resource with `service.name: sdmetrics` carries
`sdmetrics.sources`, `sdmetrics.sources.failed`,
`sdmetrics.scrape.duration`, `sdmetrics.source.up`,
`sdmetrics.source.scrape.duration`, `sdmetrics.source.unit.resolved` and
`sdmetrics.metrics.dropped`.

See the [mapping reference](https://rossedman.github.io/sdmetrics/reference/mapping/)
for naming, counter start times and unit resolution.

## Permissions

The Collector needs to connect to the report sockets (systemd's own are
mode 0666; others may be restricted to a group) and to read
`/proc/<pid>/cgroup` of the processes behind them. Without the latter,
sources keep the socket name as `service.name` and
`sdmetrics.source.unit.resolved` reports why.

## Building a collector

```yaml
# builder-config.yaml for the OpenTelemetry Collector Builder (ocb)
dist:
  name: otelcol-systemd
  output_path: ./otelcol-systemd
receivers:
  - gomod: github.com/rossedman/sdmetrics/receiver/systemdreportreceiver v0.1.0
exporters:
  - gomod: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/exporter/otlpexporter v0.163.0
  - gomod: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/exporter/debugexporter v0.163.0
processors:
  - gomod: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/processor/batchprocessor v0.163.0
providers:
  - gomod: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap/provider/fileprovider v1.69.0
  - gomod: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap/provider/envprovider v1.69.0
```

```sh
ocb --config builder-config.yaml
```
